svg.title: 13 · Modular KMP UI And Data Layers
svg.desc: Modular KMP UI And Data Layers. Feature one stays native inside every platform app. Feature two shares UI and data as separate KMP modules; native ViewModels connect the shared UI to shared data. Solid arrows show calls or dependencies.
